changes.old: At the order-zero bad point 1 the entire shallow collar has \(|\zeta|=1\), hence \(\mathrm d''t=0\). Away from the bad tubes the same identity holds.
changes.new: At the order-zero bad point 1, the entire shallow collar is an actual ordinary open set on which \(|\zeta|=1\); hence \(\mathrm d''t=0\) there. Away from the bad tubes we use only \(t=0\): since \(\chi\) is constant on a neighborhood of zero, \(\chi'(t)=0\) on an ordinary neighborhood of each such point. No vanishing of \(\mathrm d''t\) near the generic residual center is asserted.
